title: Advances in Ordered Fluids and Alignment Phenomena: Modeling, Analysis, and Numerical Methods
summary: Ordered fluids and alignment-driven systems (liquid crystals, active matter, biological collectives, anisotropic particulate flows) and the link between their kinetic and continuum descriptions: analysis, numerical methods and particle simulations. Invited talks of 60 minutes with 15 minutes of discussion, and time set aside for open discussion. Exact dates to be announced.
